title: Freshdesk SLA Breach Alert
summary: Scheduled check of Freshdesk tickets near or over SLA, deduplicates already-alerted tickets, sends Slack alert to owner or channel.
trigger: Manual (set up 15-minute schedule with external scheduler or cron)
seoTitle: Freshdesk SLA Breach Alerts to Slack in Real Time
answer: This template runs every 15 minutes, queries Freshdesk for open tickets within 2 hours of their SLA due date or already overdue, deduplicates tickets already alerted in the last 24 hours, then posts Slack notifications to a designated channel with breach countdown or overdue hours. Support managers see which tickets need immediate attention to avoid SLA violations and maintain service commitments.

faq.q: Can Freshdesk send SLA breach alerts to Slack natively?
faq.a: Freshdesk's native Slack app does not include SLA breach alerts. It posts ticket updates but does not proactively monitor SLA timers or send countdown warnings. This template fills that gap with scheduled checks and deduplication.

The template tracks which ticket IDs were alerted in the previous run. Each ticket is alerted once per 24-hour period, so your Slack channel does not get spammed with repeat alerts for the same overdue ticket.

faq.q: Can I customize the alert threshold?
faq.a: Yes. Set the alert_threshold_hours input to change when alerts fire. For example, 4 hours gives more lead time, 1 hour alerts only imminent breaches. The default is 2 hours.

faq.q: What happens if the Freshdesk API is slow or fails?
faq.a: The fetch call will retry automatically. If the API is down, the scheduled run logs the error and the next run tries again in 15 minutes. No alerts are sent for that interval.

faq.q: Can I route alerts to different Slack channels by priority?
faq.a: Yes. Modify the alert_slack step to conditionally post to different channels based on ticket.priority. For example, send urgent breaches to a dedicated escalation channel.

sampleOutput: Slack message: Warning: SLA Warning: Ticket #1234 breaches in 1h (High priority). Customer login issue after migration. View ticket.
whatYouNeed: Freshdesk integration connected in Ballet, Slack Bot integration connected and invited to alerts channel
failureHandling: If the Freshdesk API call fails, the error is logged and you can retry manually or via scheduler. Deduplication is in-memory per run, so if you need persistent deduplication across restarts, connect a Ballet data table.
nativeVsTemplate: Use Freshdesk's built-in automations if you only need basic ticket-created or status-change Slack posts. Use this template when you need proactive SLA monitoring with breach countdown alerts, deduplication, and custom thresholds that Freshdesk's native Slack integration cannot provide.
setup: Connect the Freshdesk and Slack Bot integrations in Ballet once.
Invite the Slack bot to your alert channel.
Publish the playbook and run it manually, or set up a 15-minute schedule using an external scheduler or cron job to trigger the playbook via API.
Set slack_channel input to your channel ID or name.
Optionally adjust alert_threshold_hours to your SLA buffer.
Each run checks for breaching tickets and posts alerts to Slack.
